name: reactor_pulse
title: Overload reactor blast

request.text: One spectacular sci-fi reactor pulse detonation at the very start. Enormous sharp energy CRACK, dense concussive low-mid body, deep sub drop and a radial tearing electromagnetic shockwave. Bright crystalline fragments scatter wide, a collapsing ion storm crackles into silence. Cinematic ultimate attack with a textured aftermath. No pre-charge, repeated blasts, voice, music or ambience.

purpose: Private audition; not yet approved for game integration.
